title: Developing L2 Speaking Fluency in Online Learning Through Two Motivation-Based Instructional Frameworks
reason: Participants are EFL learners aged 16-20 in an adult course at a state-owned language institute, not a higher- or vocational-education programme. Secondarily, only pre/post group comparisons of PRAAT fluency measures; no platform indicator.

extraction.design: quasi-experimental, two experimental groups + control (intact classes)
extraction.n_quote: The participants were 61 upper-intermediate EFL learners with an age range of 16-20 and 5 years of English learning experience.
extraction.population: upper-intermediate EFL learners at a language institute (online classes)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: speaking fluency (silent pauses, articulation rate via PRAAT)
extraction.notes: Secondary E4: group comparison of fluency outcomes only. Country from author affiliations (Shahrekord University, Iran).
